requirements.text: Allow customers to book appointments online at any time
Send automatic reminders to customers via SMS and email 24 hours and 1 hour before their appointments
Prevent double bookings in real time
Provide clear visibility into daily and weekly bookings, cancellations, and no-shows
Include a list of services with descriptions and prices for customers to select
Display a list of barbers with bios and specialties for customer selection
Allow customers to filter services and barbers based on preferences
Ensure the booking process is user-friendly and intuitive
Maintain budget constraints for implementation and ongoing costs
Ensure compliance with data protection regulations for storing customer personal information
Enforce a 24-hour notice period for cancellations with flexibility for first-time customers
Send immediate confirmation messages after booking
Provide daily and weekly summary reports on bookings, cancellations, and no-shows
Track customer no-show history to identify patterns
Analyze which services are booked the most to understand customer preferences
Provide insights to help make informed decisions regarding staffing and service offerings
